overview: TradeNest Naturals supplies Chai Masala Powder in bulk for wholesale, foodservice, and private label use. The blend is made for Indian-style milk tea and spiced tea preparations. It is finely milled, consistent in handling, and suitable for commercial kitchens, beverage production, and retail packing. We support standard and custom requirements with clear specification review before order confirmation.

We are an FSSAI-registered supplier and IEC-registered exporter with OEM and private label support. Buyers can request custom mesh, packaging, recipe strength, and label formats. We also provide samples on request, export documentation support, and bulk supply for repeat orders. Our process covers sourcing, cleaning and sorting, controlled drying, grinding and sieving, quality inspection, and packing and dispatch.

faqs.q: What is the MOQ for Chai Masala Powder?
faqs.a: The MOQ is 5 kg for this product. Larger bulk and private label quantities can be planned based on the order requirement.

faqs.q: Can you supply OEM or private label packs?
faqs.a: Yes. We support OEM and private label projects, including label formats, pack sizes, and custom packaging on request.

faqs.q: What mesh size do you supply?
faqs.a: The standard product is supplied in 60–80 mesh. Custom mesh can be discussed on request.
Common packing options include 25 kg bags, HDPE containers, 5–10 kg bags, and small private-label pouches and jars.
